acceptance.given: When compiling and freezing execution-path test bindings for FR-11, each source-declared oracle and assertion is mapped independently into compiled bindings and authored tests.

oracle.expected: A bidirectional coverage artifact shows every independent source oracle and assertion represented by its own compiled or test assertion and linked evidence node.
forbidden: Omitting, merging, or replacing an independent oracle or assertion
Using one aggregate assertion to stand in for distinct source assertions
oracle.observable: The FR-11 exact-cover or semantic coverage report lists one-to-one oracle and assertion entries with selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence links.

acceptance.then: Compilation is accepted only after independent mappings and assertions are verified.
acceptance.when: Execution-path bindings and tests are compiled or frozen.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run exact-cover verification on bindings that merge or omit an independent oracle or assertion; the report must identify the uncovered or non-independent source node.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compile independent oracle and assertion records without merging and enforce bidirectional exact-cover links through validator assertions.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain existing exact-cover schema and validator interfaces; rollback only independent-node enforcement changes.

slice_hint.state_transition: source declarations -> independent compiled nodes -> bidirectional exact-cover verification -> frozen evidence
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Exact-cover report has no orphan nodes and independently matches every oracle or assertion to selector, command, witness, and runtime evidence.
